item.title: HIGHGUARD Day One Review: A Delicious FPS Cookie That Needs More Baking In The Oven
item.description: Highguard is officially out and we are giving it our honest day one thoughts. Read on for the full review with our thoughts and why it is not that bad of a game, but it needs a lot of work.

item.title: DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS Invades FORTNITE With Five New Community Created Islands
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons has crossed over into Fortnite with five community made islands including a social hub, PvP boxfights, co-op boss fights, roguelike dungeon, and zombie adventure

item.title: OLD SCHOOL RUNESCAPE'S Deadman: Annihilation Mode Arrives This Friday With New Update
item.description: OSRS Deadman: Annihilation mode drops on Friday at 17:00 UTC. Play to earn Deadman Points for tradeable cosmetics, buy Sigils, Ruinous Powers, fight in Breaches, plus some QOL updates.

item.title: HIGHGUARD Has Had A Rough Start With Review Bombing And Game Issues
item.description: Highguard peaked at 97K Steam players day one but still sits at Mostly Negative with over 20k reviews. Game performance issues, & Concord comparisons have lead to a rough start for the game.

item.title: ELDEN RING: NIGHTREIGN Is Turning Into A Tabletop RPG This Spring
item.description: Group SNE announces that they will be releasing an Elden Ring: Nightreign TTRPG for spring 2026. Official previews for the game will be revealed soon.

item.title: DARKHAVEN Announced: DIABLO 1 And DIABLO 2 Creators Unveil Their Next-Gen ARPG Project
item.description: Darkhaven, a dark fantasy isometric ARPG from the original Diablo and Diablo II creators has been unveiled with a fresh trailer, Steam page, and Kickstarter. The devs promise a fresh take on the genre.

item.title: WARHAMMER 40K: SPACE MARINE 2's Upcoming Techmarine Class Abilities Have Been Revealed
item.description: Space Marine 2's Techmarine subclass drops in Patch 12: Servo-Gun auto-fires during melee, Tarantula turrets zone foes, Omnissian Axe sweeps hordes. Here is the first look at the new class.

item.title: GOD OF WAR Casts SEVERANCE Star Ólafur Darri Ólafsson As Thor
item.description: The God of War cast has added another major character, with How to Train Your Dragon 2 star Ólafur Darri Ólafsson set to play the show's God of Thunder, Thor.

item.title: GOD OF WAR Casts Three Major Roles, With One Actor Returning From The Games
item.description: Three more major roles have just been filled in Prime Video's God of War TV series, with actors found for Mimir, Sindri, and Brok. One of them even reprises their role from the games.
